before.body: Bunkhouse Hotels is a design-, music-, and community-led boutique hotel platform within Hyatt lifestyle group (parent-platform context). For owners, the affiliation case is lifestyle placemaking, independent character, operator and platform fit, market selectivity, and clearly labeled Hyatt parent-platform implications. It should be evaluated on its own guest promise and operating implications, not as a generic parent-brand substitute or an interchangeable peer among Tribute Portfolio, Autograph Collection, Design Hotels, Curio Collection.
